## Review verdict — ✅ accept

Re-reviewed at `43d37efe` through the declared `review-pr` operation (#3035). Correctness lens, converged at round 1 of 5. Judge spend $0.9545, 285.2s, one juror, session `2946c1e9`.

**Why a re-review.** The first pass (`review-pr-a8b1d6f1`) returned `changes` on two CONFIRMED findings — the `--all` consent bypass in `.githooks/post-merge` and `--check`'s inability to report a missing `.git` grant — and both were fixed in `43d37efe` *after* that review ran. So the recorded verdict described code that no longer exists. Recording it would have stamped a head nobody judged.

**One finding this round, a carve-out.** CONFIRMED, `worseThanBase: true`, but `parallelizable: true`, so `(introduced && worseThanBase && !parallelizable) ? BLOCKER : CARVE_OUT` derives a carve-out and the PR is not bounced:

> `selfKey`/`siblingsFor` use the raw `basename(root)` instead of resolving through `primaryCheckout(root)` first, so running the bootstrap from inside a lane clone makes the tool misidentify its own repo as an unrecognised checkout and list itself as a missing sibling.

Filed as **`#xsarpbt`** rather than fixed here — a lane clone is where agent work actually happens, so it is worth its own item, and it is independent of everything this PR changes.

Recorded by pushing a request file to `ops/review-requests`, applied by the workflow from #1476 running the real `review-set-label.mjs`.
